claims.text: The patch caused the positive share to drop by 4.51 percent at the 7-day horizon. Reviews came in a burst during this window; on such windows the method raised false alarms at most 10% of the time in its benchmark. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out.

report.summary: The patch caused the positive share to drop by 4.51 percent at the 7-day horizon. Reviews came in a burst during this window, and on such windows the method raised false alarms at most 10 percent of the time in its benchmark. The game's discounts weren't tracked at the time, so a price change can't be ruled out. The patch is supported. A price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive. Noise or seasonality is rejected.
